nodes.title: SG-8.4.4 Contribution history error message with Retry
nodes.body:
Context: ContributionSheet already loads history through listMine and has a HistoryStatus of loading, ready or error, plus a Retry button driven by reloadKey. Desired behavior: when history fails, the player sees 'Could not load your suggestions' with a Retry button, and clicking Retry reloads the history and returns to the loading state. Expected result: the behavior is confirmed in code and locked by unit tests. Why: the player must be able to recover from a failed history load without closing the modal.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given listMine rejects, When the sheet opens, Then role=alert shows 'Could not load your suggestions' and a Retry button is present
- Given the error state, When Retry is clicked, Then the error message and Retry button disappear and 'Loading your suggestions…' is shown while listMine is pending
- Given Retry is clicked, When listMine is called again and resolves, Then listMine has been called twice and the history list is shown


## Scope
- In scope: ContributionSheet history error and Retry behavior
- Out of scope: Backend changes
- Out of scope: Submit flow
- Out of scope: Empty and loading message copy
- Preserve: listMine API contract
- Preserve: HistoryStatus type
- Preserve: Existing contribution tests


## Technical constraints
- React + Zustand-free local state in ContributionSheet
- Use the real api client module, mocked only in unit tests


## Definition of done
- Error message and Retry present on failure
- Retry returns to loading and reloads history
- Unit tests pass


## Non-functional requirements
- Error is announced via role=alert


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Failed history load shows 'Could not load your suggestions' with a Retry button
nodes.body:
Context: ContributionSheet sets historyStatus to 'error' in the listMine catch. Desired behavior: in that state it renders the HISTORY_ERROR alert and a Retry button. Expected result: the player sees the explained failure and a way to retry. Why: failures must not be silent.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given listMine rejects, When the sheet is open, Then an element with role=alert has text 'Could not load your suggestions'
- Given listMine rejects, When the sheet is open, Then a button named 'Retry' is present
- Given listMine resolves, When the sheet is open, Then neither the error nor Retry is shown


## Scope
- In scope: Error alert and Retry button rendering
- Out of scope: Reload logic
- Preserve: Other alerts in the sheet


## Technical constraints
- Message text must remain 'Could not load your suggestions'


## Definition of done
- Error and Retry render only in error state


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Clicking Retry reloads history and returns to the loading state
nodes.body:
Context: the Retry button increments reloadKey, which re-runs the history effect that sets historyStatus to 'loading' and calls listMine. Desired behavior: after the click the error is gone, the loading message shows while pending, and listMine is called again. Expected result: the player sees the loading state, then the list or a new error. Why: gives clear feedback that a retry is in progress.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the error state, When Retry is clicked and listMine is pending, Then 'Loading your suggestions…' is shown and the error alert and Retry button are absent
- Given Retry is clicked, When the call settles, Then listMine has been called exactly twice
- Given Retry fails again, When the second call rejects, Then the error and Retry are shown again


## Scope
- In scope: Retry click handler and effect re-run
- Out of scope: Error copy
- Preserve: Cancellation guard in the history effect


## Technical constraints
- Reload driven by reloadKey in the effect dependencies


## Definition of done
- Retry returns to loading and refetches


## Clarifying questions
- None
